In Miehikkälä, 64 km by road from the nearest unit by drive time (Kotka), 15 or 5 breast sessions both mean 0 nights away but 16 round trips versus 6 [S60, S59].

1. The radiotherapy lead could evaluate a single 8 Gy session as the default for uncomplicated painful bone metastases (equal pain relief, more retreatment); expected nights away in Miehikkälä are 0.0 versus 0.0 for a multi-session course, serving "Patients receive treatment within target times" [S31, S30, S62, S60, S59, S25, S24]. Within 30 days, the clinical team reviews this default [S31, S30].

2. The radiotherapy lead could evaluate 5 sessions, non-inferior to 15, as the default for eligible patients (whole breast or chest wall without nodal radiotherapy), with distance as a reason, serving "Patients receive treatment within target times" [S9, S11, S15, S14, S25, S24]. Yearly, the county avoids 0 nights away and frees 578 machine sessions (calculated, breast alone) [S33, S57, S34, S35, S60]. Within 30 days, the clinical team reviews eligibility [S15, S14].

3. The director of cancer services could publish schedule mix and radiotherapy use by distance band yearly, serving "Regional differences in treatment are available and used to steer services (cross-cutting indicator)" [S26, S21]. Within 30 days, the director and the clinical team decide which figures to report [S26].

Distances are road estimates and the current schedule mix is unknown [S59, S60, S16].
